name: engine start releases every held entry, and the instance takes a fresh actor that its next commit uses (web: no fork guard)
a forkGuard equal to its backup-excluded copy keeps every replica id
a missing backup-excluded copy re-identifies every replica under a new forkGuard
a backup-excluded copy that differs re-identifies every replica too
a store without a forkGuard mints its first and re-identifies nothing
engine start answers a pending sign-in for the caller to resume
